messages:
emma_cs: Quick heads-up — yesterday's onboarding pipeline degradation hit ~12 new accounts (batch imports + vector index jobs). Several are in mid-renewal conversations; we need an incident-status + mitigation offer that protects renewal risk. @maria_support can you lead outreach? @raj_eng need short RCA + ETA for the permanent fix so we don't overpromise.

raj_eng: Root cause: queued batch processor overflowed after retry storm; KV cache eviction caused reindex thrash. We've mitigated with rate caps and a hotfix that reduces retry backoff to linear. Permanent fix (backpressure + queue sharding) targeted EOD tomorrow. ETA for full restore of backlog: 24-36h.

maria_support: I can run the outreach. Proposal: categorize customers into 3 tiers (high-touch renewals, onboarding critical, lower-risk). For high-touch we offer a tailored credit + 2-week dedicated trial and a scheduled warm-handoff call with SE. Draft message below — please review.

jordan_pm: +1 to tiering. For renewal teams: include a short "what we did" + clear next steps + a named CS owner. Avoid heavy technical detail unless customer asks.

emma_cs: Draft customer note (paste-friendly):

```
Subject: Update on recent onboarding delays — account impact & next steps

Hi <Customer Name>,

We’re reaching out with an update regarding onboarding delays you experienced on <date>. Our engineers identified a queue retry storm that temporarily delayed batch imports and embedding indexing for a subset of accounts.

What we did:
- Applied immediate rate caps and a hotfix to stop retry amplification.
- Prioritized your account in the backlog and applied a manual reindex run.

What we’re doing next:
- Full fix (queue sharding + backpressure) deploying by <date/time>.
- You should see completed indexing within 24–36 hours; we’ll notify you when finished.

Compensation: As a gesture, we’d like to offer <credit amount> or a 2‑week Dedicated trial credit (your choice). We can also schedule a 30‑minute SE session to walk through the reindex and ensure your prompts/pipelines are optimized.

Point of contact: <CS rep name> (<email/phone>)

We’re sincerely sorry for the disruption — we know this impacts your launch timelines and renewal planning. Please let me know if you prefer a call.

Thanks,
The Redwood Inference team
```

raj_eng: That template looks good. For the RCA note that goes to engineering-savvy customers, use: "Cause: retry amplification causing queue overflow -> cache evictions -> reindex backlog." Avoid deep logs unless requested.

maria_support: I will split the list and start 1:1 messages to the 5 highest-risk customers with the template + offer. I'll cc renewals on each thread. Planning to send first batch by 11:30am PST. Please thumbs-up if approved.

opsbot: Incident INC-2026-0456 created; severity=high; customer-impact=true; owning-team=ingestion.

emma_cs: Approved. Please swap <credit amount> to either a $200 account credit or 2-week Dedicated trial, whichever the customer prefers. @jordan_pm I flagged 3 accounts for Renewal Outreach; will add notes to their renewal trackers.

maria_support: Sending first batch now. Will post results and any escalations here. :rocket:
